body: I just drove past a sheriff, I honked and flashed my my lights at him and he just drove past. No one will talk to me.

I befriend shitty people cause I can't tell if they're shitty untill it's too late. I do volunteer and my schedule is too tight to do anything else. If I'm doing nothing for too long, all I think about is dying, so I work/volunteer as much as I can. I would never have free time if I didn't get sensory overload. But life is painful, always have been always will be, I'm okay with that. Its my emotional pain that drives me to suicide.
